title: Learning Tracks
description: Main study areas included in the roadmap.

items.name: AZ-104 Azure Administrator
items.detail: Azure identity, governance, networking, storage, compute and monitoring.

items.name: MS-102 Microsoft 365 Administrator
items.detail: Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint and security concepts.

items.name: Infrastructure operations
items.detail: Change planning, maintenance, runbooks, validation, access reviews and troubleshooting.

title: Toolkit
description: Tools to learn and use while building the roadmap and practice projects.

items.name: VS Code and Obsidian
items.detail: Primary tools for code, Markdown notes, documentation and project write-ups.

items.name: PowerShell 7 and Python
items.detail: Main scripting languages for automation, reporting, API work and operational tooling.

items.name: Git, GitHub and GitHub Actions
items.detail: Version control, portfolio history, automated checks and deployment practice.

items.name: Node.js and Vite
items.detail: Frontend tooling used to build and deploy this roadmap website.

title: Practice Environments
description: Safe places to learn without affecting production systems.

items.name: Cloud development environment
items.detail: Useful for Microsoft 365, Azure, Graph and proof-of-concept learning where available.

items.name: Personal home lab
items.detail: Useful for Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PowerShell, Docker and documentation practice.

items.name: Microsoft 365 developer tenant
items.detail: Useful for safe Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Graph, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams and Intune experiments.

title: Project Backlog
description: Ideas to turn learning into visible portfolio evidence.

items.name: Starter and leaver automation
items.detail: Document the workflow, then prototype small reporting, checklist or account-lifecycle scripts.

items.name: Windows deployment automation
items.detail: Study unattended setup, naming conventions, build consistency and deployment documentation.

items.name: Infrastructure dashboard
items.detail: Create a lightweight dashboard for lab status, reports or automation output.

items.name: Documentation automation
items.detail: Generate notes, checklists or reports from structured data such as JSON, CSV or Markdown.

title: Evidence To Build
description: Outputs that make the roadmap useful and presentable.

items.name: README files
items.detail: Explain each project, what it does, how to run it and what was learned.

items.name: Diagrams and screenshots
items.detail: Show architecture, workflows, lab builds, command output and successful tests.

items.name: Runbooks and troubleshooting notes
items.detail: Record repeatable steps, failures, fixes and validation checks.

items.name: Small working prototypes
items.detail: Prefer simple finished examples over large unfinished ideas.
